description: This is a Python source file implementing a FastAPI application that serves mock endpoints for user plan data and features. It includes route handlers, data models, and in-memory user data, designed for demo and testing purposes.

classes.name: UserDataRequest
classes.description: Request model for user data requests, requiring a username.

classes.name: FeatureRequest
classes.description: Request model for user feature info requests, requiring a username.

classes.name: UserDataResponse
classes.description: Response model for /user/data endpoint, returning username, plan, and plan-specific data.

classes.name: UserFeatureResponse
classes.description: Response model for /user/feature endpoint, returning username, plan, and features description.

methods.name: str get_plan_for_username(username: str)

methods.name: get_user_data(username: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="The username (alice, bob, or carol)"))
methods.description: Endpoint handler that returns plan-specific data based on username query parameter.

methods.name: post_user_data(request: UserDataRequest = Body(...))
methods.description: Endpoint handler accepting JSON body with username to return user data.

methods.name: get_user_feature(username: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="The username (alice, bob, or carol)"))
methods.description: Endpoint returning feature summaries for a given username query parameter.

methods.name: post_user_feature(request: FeatureRequest = Body(...))
methods.description: Endpoint accepting JSON body with username to return feature info.

methods.name: list_users()
methods.description: Endpoint that lists all user names with their associated plans for demo purposes.

methods.name: custom_openapi()
methods.description: Function to generate a customized OpenAPI schema with demo notes.
